order: Execution Order: Revision of the Entry-State Indicator and Related Fixes (6 October 2026, revised), section 6b

exclude.rule: a ticker on one of these lists is left out of both the operator's and the tiers' comparison and listed with its category; every other position is an individual stock

beta.rule: the slope of the stock's daily returns on QQQ's over the 252 sessions before the position's measured start (canonical closes); with fewer than 60 sessions the beta is 1 and the position says so

definitions.shadow: every dollar put into a position goes into QQQ at that session's QQQ close, and every dollar taken out comes out of QQQ on the same date; a position held when the window opens enters at that close's value
definitions.difference: the position's value (or, once closed, nothing) less the QQQ shadow's value at the as-of close; for a closed position this is the dollars in times (the position's return minus QQQ's over the same dates)
definitions.difference_pct: the summed difference divided by the dollars put in (the opening value of positions held at the window's start plus every purchase)
definitions.risk_adjusted: the same with a shadow that holds beta dollars of QQQ per dollar in the position (beta measured before the position's start): each position's return in excess of beta times QQQ's return, in dollars, summed by position
definitions.closed_beat: closed positions whose difference is positive, over all closed positions in the window
definitions.decisions: independent decisions = distinct entry dates of the positions counted (a position held when the record begins counts its first recorded session; the algorithmic tiers pooled count distinct dates across tiers, since the tiers rebalance on the same scoring)
definitions.prices: the tournament record's as-published closes for every session (positions and QQQ alike), a reported trade price where the log carries one; price returns, dividends left out
definitions.first_logged_trade: the earliest date the transactions log allows for the operator's first trade row (a buy, sell, entry or exit; a reported date range counts from its first day); the window opens at the close before it

skill_note: With fewer than about 30 independent decisions the comparison is descriptive: it cannot distinguish skill from chance.
